extras: Windows only; requires separate ClingNote companion for Windows. Pro is a $20 one-time payment.
problem: Users lose track of relevant notes when switching between different applications, files, or web pages during a workflow.

relations.evidence: ClingNote needs a small separate Windows program, the ClingNote companion, to know which file, app or web page is in front.

summary: Attaches Obsidian notes to Windows contexts (files, folders, apps, web pages) and automatically opens the relevant note when switching back to that context.
